description: This file manages Nostr profile creation, conversion between schema and content formats, event creation, publishing to relays, and profile validation/sanitization.

methods.name: profileToContent
methods.description: Converts a NostrProfile schema object to NIP-01 ProfileContent format, stripping undefined fields and validating URLs.

methods.name: contentToProfile
methods.description: Converts NIP-01 ProfileContent back to NostrProfile schema, useful for importing profiles.

methods.name: createProfileEvent
methods.description: Creates a signed kind:0 profile event with monotonic timestamp.

methods.name: publishProfileEvent
methods.description: Publishes a profile event to multiple relays in parallel, reporting successes and failures.

methods.name: publishProfile
methods.description: Creates and publishes a profile event in one call.

methods.name: validateProfile
methods.description: Validates a profile object without throwing, returning validation result.

methods.name: sanitizeProfileForDisplay
methods.description: Sanitizes profile text fields to prevent XSS by escaping HTML characters.
